$comment: What deploy/configure.mjs generates and deploy/release.mjs deploys. `workers` is in dependency order: callees before callers (viz-ingest binds viz-publisher's Publisher class; viz-ruler calls viz-query, viz-ingest and viz-control; viz-mcp calls viz-query, viz-control and viz-ruler; viz-gateway calls all of them but viz-publisher). Promotion follows this order; rollback goes the other way. Every Durable Object class a Worker defines is declared under `schemas` (its SchemaSpec, `<path>.ts#<EXPORT>`, read into release records: contracts/COMPATIBILITY.md §6) or `unversioned` (why it keeps no storage).

shared_vars.$comment: Deployment-wide values every Worker must agree on. Applied to each Worker whose own config declares the var; a differing component value is overridden and reported.

script_aliases.$comment: Names components use today for the write-path script. All of them are viz-ingest.

unversioned.Leaf: keeps nothing between calls: no storage, no fields, no alarm (query/src/leaf.ts)
